scripts.text:
You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation:
您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You... don't look familiar to me... ?
Are you going to threaten me?
No, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...我不認識你吧...？
你要威脅我嗎？
不會吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From now on, I'll stay here quietly and not interrupt anyone until the siege ends.
Don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
從現在開始，我會安靜地待在這裡，直到攻城戰結束，不會打擾任何人。
別擔心我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I feel so grateful all the time about you letting me stay here.
It's nothing special... but if you want, I'll make you tools that could be of use.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一直很感激你讓我留在這裡。
雖然沒什麼特別的...但如果你願意，我可以為你打造一些有用的工具。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... Master.
I feel so thankful all the time.
Since I owe you big time, I'll help you with anything anytime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...師父。
我一直都很感激您。
既然我欠您這麼多，無論何時，只要您需要，我都會幫忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you hear the news?
The girls are coming.
The merciless girls!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你聽到訊息了嗎？
女孩們要來了。
那些無情的女孩們！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah stop following me around!
If you could just get rid of them... Jormungand, that's right! I'll make you Jormungand!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，別跟著我了！
如果你能擺脫她們就好了...耶夢加得，沒錯！我會為你打造耶夢加得！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Although I managed to escape from them again...
it's hard.
life is... just so hard.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...雖然我又成功從她們手中逃脫了...
但這很難。
生活...真的好難。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can finally breathe now.
I'll start making Jormungand as promised.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我終於可以喘口氣了。
我會開始打造承諾過的耶夢加得。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm tired a little bit.
I think I should rest for a few days.
I may look just fine, but I was mentally very tired.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有點累了。
我想休息幾天。
我看起來可能沒事，但我精神上非常疲憊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's strange.
I can't tell how I feel.
Am I having some kind of a health problem?
Is it something uncurable?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很奇怪。
我說不清自己是什麼感覺。
我是不是有什麼健康問題？
這是某種無法治癒的病嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have my reasons.
Please, pretend not to see me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有我的理由。
請假裝沒看到我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean if the guild master wants it.
I'm also a master who pursues the ultimate way.
I hope I can find that way here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說，如果公會會長想要的話。
我也是一位追求極致之道的師父。
我希望我能在這裡找到那條路。

scripts.text: Make Jormungand.
scripts.translation: 打造耶夢加得

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Relax.
scripts.translation: 極速恢復

scripts.text:
^ff0000Wizardry staff is needed in the process of making Jormungand.
You should not possess any other items except for Wizardry Staffs in order to proceed with the quest.^ff0000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000打造耶夢加得的過程中需要大巫師之杖。
為了繼續任務，您除了大巫師之杖外，不應持有其他任何物品。^ff0000

scripts.text:
^ff0000Even if the refinement level and cards have been applied, the process requires any one of the Wizardry Staffs you may have.
Please try again after organizing your possessions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000即使已經應用了精煉等級和卡片，過程也需要您擁有的任意一根大巫師之杖。
請在整理您的物品後重試。^000000

scripts.text: Organize possessions.
scripts.translation: 整理物品

scripts.text: Continue as it is.
scripts.translation: 保持現狀

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Wizardry Staffs only.
scripts.translation: 您已決定只保留大巫師之杖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you've developed the fortress as you promised.
Moreover, you've found Twilight of Trail...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你如約發展了要塞。
而且，你還找到了黃昏之跡...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... so..let's get the work done.
Before the girls find us...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 那麼...讓我們開始工作吧。
在那群女孩找到我們之前...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The girls... ?

[{0}]
... yeah, there were some girls..
I had to run away because of them...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 是的，有幾個女孩...
因為她們，我不得不逃跑了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no... !
They're here..!!

[{0}]
Leave it to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
交給我吧。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Instruction -!
Soon, 7 girls that are after {0} will try to invade the fortress.
You have to protect {1} for 1 hour.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 任務說明 -!
很快，7個追捕{0}的女孩將試圖入侵要塞。
你需要保護{1}長達1小時。^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Instruction -!
When the actual attack starts, the doorway of Emperium region will be blocked up for protection.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 任務說明 -!
當實際攻擊開始時，華麗金屬區域的入口將被封鎖以進行防禦。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jormungand is a staff that is modeled on Jormungand, the son of god who embraces the world.
It also refers to Ragnarok, the twilight of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
耶夢加得是以擁抱世界的神之子耶夢加得為原型製作的法杖。
它也象徵著諸神的黃昏。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, here we have items that symbolize the twilight of the gods...
and I can't believe I'm going to use them to make Jormungand myself... with my own hands!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，這裡有著象徵諸神黃昏的物品...
我無法相信我會親手用它們來打造耶夢加得...用我自己的雙手！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, it seems like we need more materials.
Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，看來我們需要更多材料。
你能再檢查一下嗎？我會給你一份所需材料的清單。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, would it be okay if I said something?
Jormungand is one of the most powerful battlegears I make and you deserve to receive something like that from me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，我能說點別的嗎？
耶夢加得是我打造的最強大的戰鬥裝備之一，你值得從我這裡得到這樣的東西...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
but I would like you to have the minimum qualification at least.
Manage this fortress well and raise ^4d4dffits commerce level by 30 or more^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但我希望你至少具備最低資格。
好好管理這座要塞，並將^4d4dff其商業等級提升30點或更多^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
With great power comes great responsibility and duty.
I would like you to master the basics first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
能力越大，責任和職責就越大。
我希望你先掌握基礎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make Jormungand afterward.
Let me give you the list of materials if you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
之後我會打造耶夢加得。
如果你願意，我可以給你一份材料清單。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is so nice of you to say that.
By the way, I wonder how my older brother Kai is doing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你這麼說真是太好了。
順便問一下，不知道我哥哥凱現在過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sure he's doing fine just like I am.
... I hope things stay as peaceful as they are now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我相信他和我一樣過得很好。
... 我希望事情能像現在這樣保持和平。

scripts.text:
Did you hear the news?
The girls are coming.
The merciless girls!!!
scripts.translation:
你聽到訊息了嗎？
女孩們要來了。
那些無情的女孩們！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They'll get here any minute since they've declared war already.
I'm sure they're coming to get Jormungand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她們已經宣戰了，隨時都會到達。
我確信她們是來搶耶夢加得的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stop them. Please!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阻止她們。拜託了！

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the girls?'
scripts.translation: 你說“女孩們”是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you...
I'm sorry that I'm causing you troubles, but my hands are tied.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你...
抱歉給你添麻煩了，但我現在身不由己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please, stop them for me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜託，幫我把她們趕走！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... They are the girls who want to be Valkyries...
and they always go around in groups of seven.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...她們是想成為瓦爾基里的女孩...
而且總是七個人一組到處跑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What they want is a powerful battlegear...
They always threatened my older brother Kai and me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她們想要強大的戰鬥裝備...
她們一直威脅我和我哥哥凱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They were satisfied with basic weapons at first, but
soon they started threatening us saying that they need something more powerful in order to become Valkyries.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
起初她們對普通武器還滿意，但很快就開始威脅我們，說她們需要更強大的東西才能成為瓦爾基里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I couldn't stand it, so I ran away... but they're here...
You have to be careful since they found out that materials for Jormungand are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受不了了，就跑掉了...但她們還是來了...
她們發現這裡有耶夢加得的材料，所以你一定要小心。

scripts.text:
Ah stop following me around!
If you could just get rid of them... Jormungand, that's right! I'll make you Jormungand!
scripts.translation:
別跟著我了！
如果你能把她們趕走...耶夢加得，沒錯！我會為你打造耶夢加得！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When will they ever stop following me...
Now I'm scared of girls in general... and I'm too scared to do anything...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她們到底什麼時候才能放過我...
我現在看到女孩就害怕...嚇得什麼都做不了...

scripts.text:
He's babbling now.
Just wait and he'll calm down.
You have to get rid of those girls first.
scripts.translation:
他現在在胡言亂語。
等一等，他會冷靜下來的。
你得先把那些女孩趕走。

scripts.text:
... Although I managed to escape from them again...
it's hard.
life is... just so hard.
scripts.translation:
...雖然我又成功逃掉了...
但這很難。
生活...真的好難。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm so exhausted that I can't do anything.
... I don't think I can do anything for a while, whether it's producing or smithing or whatever it is.
I'm sorry. I'll take a break.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我累得什麼都做不了了。
...我想我暫時什麼都做不了，無論是生產還是鍛造，什麼都行。
抱歉，我要休息一下。

scripts.text:
I can finally breathe now.
I'll start making Jormungand as promised.
scripts.translation:
我終於可以喘口氣了。
我會按承諾開始打造耶夢加得。

scripts.text: Make Jormungand.
scripts.translation: 打造耶夢加得

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 現在不行。

scripts.text:
^ff0000Wizardry staff is needed in the process of making Jormungand.
You should not possess any other items except for Wizardry Staffs in order to proceed with the quest.^ff0000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000打造耶夢加得的過程中需要大巫師之杖。
為了繼續任務，您除了大巫師之杖外，不應持有其他任何物品。^ff0000

scripts.text:
^ff0000Even if the refinement level and cards have been applied, the process requires any one of the Wizardry Staffs you may have.
Please try again after organizing your possessions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000即使已經應用了精煉等級和卡片，過程也需要您擁有的任意一根大巫師之杖。
請在整理您的物品後重試。^000000

scripts.text: Organize possessions.
scripts.translation: 整理物品

scripts.text: Continue as it is.
scripts.translation: 保持現狀

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Wizardry Staffs only.
scripts.translation: 您已決定只保留大巫師之杖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... thank you.
I can't believe I'm finally touching these materials myself...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...謝謝你。
真不敢相信我終於能親手觸控這些材料了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here it is.
Wasn't it fast although we had to go through many steps?
I was so overwhelmed that it felt as short as a moment.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了。
雖然過程很複雜，但完成得很快吧？
我當時太緊張了，感覺只過了一瞬間。

scripts.text:
Jormungand, a powerful weapon and collection of all traces in myths, is finally made
at the hands of {0}.
scripts.translation:
耶夢加得，這件蘊含神話中所有痕跡的強大武器，
終於由{0}打造完成。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whew.. I don't think I can work for a while.
I'm all exhausted. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼...我想我暫時沒法工作了。
我累壞了。哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, it seems like we need more materials.
Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，看來我們需要更多材料。
你能再檢查一下嗎？我會給你一份所需材料的清單。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now is actually the right time to make it.
By the time next Emperium appears, there won't be any chances left.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實現在正是打造它的好時機。
等到下次華麗金屬出現時，就沒機會了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, keep in mind the fact that I can only do this once a week.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，請記住我每週只能做一次。

scripts.text:
I'm tired a little bit.
I think I should rest for a few days.
I may look just fine, but I was mentally very tired.
scripts.translation:
我有點累了。
我想休息幾天。
雖然看起來沒事，但我精神上非常疲憊。

scripts.text:
It's strange.
I can't tell how I feel.
Am I having some kind of a health problem?
Is it something uncurable?
scripts.translation:
真奇怪。
我說不清自己是什麼感覺。
我是不是有什麼健康問題？
這是治不好的病嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4d4dff4 Presberk's Leather
1 Spirit of Hugin
1 Spirit of Munin
4 Giant's Chisel
1 Jormungand's Rib
1 Wizardry Staff
1 Muspellium and Essence of Rune, respectively^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^4d4dff4 普雷伯克的皮革
1 福金之魂
1 霧尼之魂
4 巨人的鑿子
1 耶夢加得的肋骨
1 大巫師之杖
1 精魔礦石和1 符文魔力精髓^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We need as many materials as these
{1}
By the way, Muspellium and Essence of Rune need to be made separately with additional materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們需要像這些一樣多的材料
{1}
順便說一下，精魔礦石和符文魔力精髓需要用額外的材料分別製作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In order to make Muspellium, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons^000000.
For Essence of Rune, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了製作精魔礦石，你需要^4d4dff50 鋁和50 神之金屬^000000。
為了製作符文魔力精髓，你需要^4d4dff200 古代符文原石和100 神秘符文原石^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make Muspellium and Essence of Rune anytime upon your request,
and of course, I'll make Jormungand as soon as we gather all the materials needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要你提出要求，我隨時可以為你製作精魔礦石和符文魔力精髓。
當然，一旦我們集齊了所有材料，我會立刻打造耶夢加得。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What I'm doing is never enough compared to what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我所做的，與你為我所做的一切相比，微不足道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, you won't be able to find Twilight of Trail.
... but people say it definitely appears to those who truly want it. I wish you all the luck.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，你無法找到“足跡的黃昏”。
...但人們說，它一定會出現在真正渴望它的人面前。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Which material do you want to make?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想製作哪種材料？

scripts.text: Muspellium
scripts.translation: 精魔礦石

scripts.text: Essence of Rune
scripts.translation: 符文魔力精髓

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make Muspellium with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會用你準備好的材料製作精魔礦石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In order to make Muspellium,
^4d4dffyou need 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了製作精魔礦石，
^4d4dff你需要50 鋁和50 神之金屬。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It shouldn't take long.
Here it is.
It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
應該不用太久。
好了。
這是製作赫爾薇爾和耶夢加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We should have all the materials ready, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們應該已經備齊所有材料了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make Essence of Rune with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會用你準備好的材料製作符文魔力精髓。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For Essence of Rune,
^4d4dffyou need 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了製作符文魔力精髓，
^4d4dff你需要200 古代符文原石和100 神秘符文原石。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It shouldn't take long.
Here it is.
It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
應該不用太久。
好了。
這是製作赫爾薇爾和耶夢加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Surely, it takes a lot...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
確實，需要很多...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tell me whenever you need it.
I'm glad I can at least do this for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
隨時告訴我你需要什麼。
我很高興至少能為你做這些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, a place where you can find materials for {1}...
this is like a dream place for me, too.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，一個可以找到{1}材料的地方...
對我來說，那裡也如同夢境一般。

scripts.text: password?
scripts.translation: 密碼？

scripts.text: Go away
scripts.translation: 走開

scripts.text:
Current Status: {0}
0: Able to proceed with the quest
1: Proceed with the quest. 10-minute wait
2: Quest in progress
3: Quest failed
4: Able to produce items , 5: Items produced successfully.
scripts.translation:
當前狀態：{0}
0：可以開始任務
1：開始任務。等待10分鐘
2：任務進行中
3：任務失敗
4：可以製作物品
5：物品製作成功

scripts.text:
Princess Status: {0}
Current Commerce Level of the Fortress:{1}
scripts.translation:
公主狀態：{0}
